links.outcome: Hallucination correction by the verifier stage and overall hallucination rate and factuality across one-, two-, three-stage variants
links.effect: Verifier corrected 85.6% of identified hallucinations, but the hallucination rate stayed 0.6116 (three-stage) vs 0.6109 (one/two-stage) and factuality was 0.843 vs 0.845.
links.quote: However, the clinical verifier demonstrated substantial effectiveness, correcting 85.6% of identified hallucinations.

unlisted_practices: Multi-stage draft, verify, and refine generation with role-specific prompts for radiology report generation
Parameter-efficient LoRA fine-tuning of a small language model for resource-constrained settings

screen.reason: The study develops and tests a new multi-stage model architecture (Swin-Qwen3 with multi-agent verification) on the IU X-Ray benchmark dataset. Ablation of the internal model stages is architecture development rather than evaluating an organizational deployment practice or safeguard.
